attack_techniques: Obfuscated Files or Information: Compile After Delivery (T1027.004)
attackers_goals: Compile payloads on the host to evade detection.
description: Attackers may use csc.exe to compile payloads on a compromised machine.
investigative_actions: Investigate the payload being compiled. Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Possible malicious .NET compilation started by a commonly abused process
